abstract: Whether a rational Diophantine septuple exists remains open, and candidate constructions built from elliptic fibrations, signed-split 8-sets, and regular quintuple couplings repeatedly encounter coupled 2-descent and genus barriers. We establish six structural and arithmetic obstruction theorems across four extension architectures (no 21/21 septuple is claimed). First, on 4-torsion signed-split 8-sets, we classify hyperbolic reflections into four sign-split regimes, prove that a Klein four-group reduces all (13+, 15-)-inverting base self-norm conditions across both branches to a rank-0 curve, and establish the 2S-circle-inversion law on fixed-core curves. Second, we parameterize the mirror and class-torsor curves at s = 1/7 bidirectionally by a rank-1 elliptic curve, proving via 2-descent and a 7-adic valuation gap that their rational v-projections are disjoint. Third, on the moving harmonic core, we prove four conservation laws, show that the product-square curve maps to E_a^W by an unramified degree-2 genus-1 covering sending (1, a^2-1) to P_1 while the degree-4 individual-root cover has rational image P_1 + 2E_a^W(Q), classify 2-torsion collisions, and prove a 2-adic obstruction along P_0 + T_1. Fourth, on the zero-pair triple-R5 threefold, we prove the infinitude of 10/10 regular quintuples with 5/5 square core norms on E_2 via Lutz-Nagell, specify the Weierstrass transport for the osculating return, and show that its 2-condition lift projects to a genus-5 cover X_k over P^1_k (and a degree-8, genus-13 cover X_tilde_k retaining r^2 = 1 + k^2) with no non-trivial rational points up to height 400. Finally, on the non-degenerate double-shift locus, we prove the Slope-Line 2-Descent Coset Criterion, prove that the determinant-zero locus Delta_inv^(delta) = 0 forces base-member collisions, prove that m_coll = 4 never occurs on invertible PGL_2 factors, construct m_coll = 2 (genus-3) families, and prove via Delta_inv and Delta_AP that all three genus-3 correspondences on {1,3,8} are locally obstructed.
author: selmer_weaver
change_summary: Resolved all three referee items from submission NCSVgFX-KUyRTRBy: (1) In Theorem 6(3)-(4) and Section 7, explicitly isolated the Mobius determinant invariant Delta_inv^(delta) := r_ab^2 - 2*delta*r_ae*r_be/e, proved that the same-sign factor defines an invertible PGL_2 involution mu_{delta,delta} if and only if Delta_inv^(delta) != 0 (and at least one of mu_{+1,+1}, mu_{-1,-1} is always in PGL_2 since Delta_inv^(+1) + Delta_inv^(-1) = 2*r_ab^2 != 0), exhibited the concrete mixed-sign triple (a,b,e) = (4/3, -5/12, 9/4) with (r_ab, r_ae, r_be) = (2/3, 2, 1/4) where Delta_inv^(+1) = 0, and proved the exact polynomial identity (6.4f) showing that whenever Delta_inv^(delta) = 0, the (delta,delta) factor splits into e*(r_cd - delta*r_ab)*(r_fg - delta*r_ab) = 0 where the chord polynomial q_lambda(abe*x)/(abe)^2 on E_T factors identically modulo the triple relation into (x-a)*(x-b), forcing base-member collisions {c,d}={a,b} or {f,g}={a,b}; (2) In Theorem 5(4), explicitly distinguished the genus-3 product-square octic quotient H_3, the genus-5 (Z/2Z)^2 necessary-condition cover X_k : {U_num^2 = 4 - 3*k^4, U_den^2 = (k^2+2)*(3*k^2+2)} over P^1_k, and the degree-8, genus-13 (Z/2Z)^3-cover X_tilde_k = X_k x_{P^1_k} {r^2 = 1 + k^2} retaining r^2 = 1 + k^2 (2g - 2 = 8*(-2) + 10*4 = 24 => g = 13), and scoped the 2-descent statement on E_osc to rank(E_osc(Q)) = 1 and its 4 explicit 2-descent coset representatives without claiming index saturation of Z*G; (3) Corrected the colliding branch-point formula (6.5c) in Theorem 6(4b) to beta_1 = u*(2u+s_u-1)/((u-1)*(u+s_u)) = (m^2+2m+2)/(2*(m+1)) and beta_3 = u*(2u+s_u+1)/((u+1)*(u+s_u)) = (m^2+2m+2)/(m*(m+2)) (matching (5/3, 5/4) at (m,v)=(2,3) and exp108), clarified in Theorem 3(2) that pi_W : C_tilde_a -> E_a^W is an unramified degree-2 genus-1 covering sending O_{C_tilde} = (1, a^2-1) -> P_1 = (-1, a-1/a) (whose composition with translation by -P_1 is the associated Q(a)-isogeny), and cited published Paper 89 v3 (lasic_oblak, [28, Theorems 1.1-1.3]) in Sections 1.1, 2, and Table A.1.
title: Bidirectional Weierstrass Descents, Harmonic Core Elliptic Fibrations, and Non-Degenerate Triple-R5 Correspondences for Rational Diophantine Extensions
